name: Broadridge Financial Solutions
description: Broadridge is the plumbing behind shareholder communication and securities back offices. Its largest business sends proxy materials and voting, mutual-fund and regulatory documents, and customer statements and bills, on behalf of public companies, funds and banks; about 30 percent of its revenue is pass-through postage and distribution cost that earns little profit. Its second business (Global Technology and Operations) sells subscription software and outsourced processing for trade settlement and recordkeeping to broker-dealers and wealth managers. Most revenue is recurring and tied to the number of shareholder positions and accounts, plus event-driven revenue from contested votes, fund proxies and corporate actions. It also holds Canton Network digital coins earned as a blockchain validator.

businessLines.name: Investor Communication Solutions (ICS)
businessLines.how: Recurring fees per shareholder position and per document for delivering proxy materials and processing votes (regulatory), fund and issuer communications, and customer statements and bills; plus event-driven fees on contested votes and mutual-fund proxies; plus pass-through distribution revenue (postage and printing) billed at cost with a small margin.

businessLines.name: Global Technology and Operations (GTO)
businessLines.how: Recurring fees for SaaS and outsourced trade processing, settlement and recordkeeping, order management and wealth-management platforms; priced per trade volume, per account and per seat, plus a small amount of Canton Network (blockchain) services revenue ($16.5M in FY2026). All revenue in this segment is recurring.
